text:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing rollout plan for per-tenant adaptive fallbacks. Targeting next-week ship. Need to lock phases, canary metrics, customer gates, and explicit fallback priority.

sam: +1. My proposal:
- phase 0: dev/staging only
- phase 1: 5% internal beta tenants (smoke)
- phase 2: 20% allowlist customers (non-critical), include two enterprise pilots in eu-central-1
- phase 3: full ramp with auto-throttle across regions (start us-west-2 -> eu-central-1 -> ap-southeast-1)

eli: Ops guardrails: must have kill-switch and auto-evict when p95 latency > 800ms OR error rate > 1.5x baseline. Add tracing tag fallback_reason for all fallbacks.

maya: Canary health metrics (hard gates): request success rate >= 99.5%, p95 latency <= baseline + 150ms, fallback invocation <= 3%, cost delta per-token <= +20%, and no semantic regressions on 5 golden prompts. These must be observed for 48h in phase1.

angela: Customer asks: two EU customers want early access + telemetry export and per-tenant opt-out. We'll implement an opt-out boolean behind the flag. Can we scope phase2 to include them?

sam: Yes. Sampling approach: hashed tenant_id -> stable cohort. Phase1=5% sample, phase2 add allowlist entries for pilot customers. A/B adds overhead; prefer post-launch unless customers insist.

maya: PM stance: defer A/B unless pilot customers require side-by-side. Angela?

angela: They asked for side-by-side but will accept a 2-week pilot in phase2 if we promise a short comparison window. Otherwise postpone.

eli: Required infra before customer exposure:
1) Flag controls: global percent, region override, tenant allowlist, tenant opt-out
2) Circuit breaker: per-region error window -> auto-disable region for 10m
3) Fallback order: primary -> model-variant -> cached response -> canned minimal fallback (with telemetry)
4) Synthetic probes every 5m against canary tenants to detect regressions
5) RBAC + audit for allowlist edits; >25% changes require 2FA confirmation

sam: Ops config example (human-readable): flag=per_tenant_adaptive_fallbacks, scopes=[global,region,tenant], percent=5, allowlist=[ids], opt_out=[ids], rollback_window_minutes=30, auto_evict_thresholds={p95:800,error_rate_mult:1.5}.

maya: Good — include rollback_window_minutes and auto_evict_thresholds in the flag schema before ship.

angela: Launch sign-off checklist:
- phase1 metrics stable for 48h
- alerts to #eng-oncall and #product wired
- customer pilot contracts + telemetry consent signed
- docs + SDK flag examples published
- runbook, kill-switch flow, and postmortem template ready

sam: Ops will own runbook and kill-switch. I'll build a health dashboard and SLA tracker. Dashboard should show per-tenant fallbacks, p95, error-rate delta, and cost delta.

eli: Also ensure trace sampling for pilot tenants and tag propagation. No manual toggles >25% without 2nd approver.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging -> canary on 2024-06-11T15:00Z (sha:caf3b2). Monitor tags: per_tenant_adaptive_fallbacks, canary.

maya: Owners / next steps:
- sam: dashboard + runbook by EOD Friday
- eli: circuit breaker + eviction logic PR by Thursday
- angela: finalize pilot customer list and contracts
- maya: finalize rollout plan, add golden prompts, and prepare sign-off doc

angela: If we trim scope (no A/B) we can hit next-week timeline. :eyes: 

sam: I'll prep sampling script and a short QA demo.

maya: Reconvene Thursday after PR reviews. Any phase1 metric trip -> auto-hold + escalate. Thanks all. :pray:
